compositing: Use with SwiftUI blendMode(.screen) so the pure black background disappears over the mailbox scene.
revised_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: mobile game UI overlay asset for a watercolor forest mailbox scene
Primary request: Create a standalone golden radial glow overlay on a perfectly pure black background. The glow should feel like warm sunlight and magical mail arrival light radiating from a mailbox, with a bright warm-gold center, many soft irregular watercolor light rays spreading outward in all directions, subtle dust-like sparkles, and feathered edges. The visual should be painterly and organic, not geometric, not a hard ring, not neon, and not a UI icon.
Composition: square image, centered glow, rays extending broadly but fading into black at the edges. Strongest light at center, medium rays around it, fine sparkles near center and lower area.
Background: absolute solid black (#000000) for screen blend compositing. No gradients or texture in the background except the glow itself.
Avoid: no mailbox, no objects, no text, no labels, no border, no frame, no arrows, no UI button, no hard circles, no lens flare artifacts, no colored rainbow flare, no visible white rectangle.
